images.filename: View of Aarhus seen from inside Dokk1 Aarhus Main Library Denmark 05.jpg
images.caption: View of Aarhus inner harbour and skyline seen through panorama windows from inside Dokk1 Aarhus Main Library Denmark. The coast road and Aarhus Ø docklands skylines are visible. A single chair is in the middle of the floor, facing the view. The highly polished floor seems blue, reflecting the daylight blue sky outside. Figures of people standing by the windows, backs to us, looking at the view, are almost in silhouette. A single person is seated just at the bottom left of frame, a computer on their lap. Photo (c)Ciara Ní Riain
images.alt: View of Aarhus inner harbour and skyline seen through panorama windows from inside Dokk1 Aarhus Main Library Denmark. The coast road and Aarhus Ø docklands skylines are visible.
